**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is considering getting a bird feeder for their backyard.  
[FACT] User recently attended a bird watching workshop at the local Audubon society a month ago.  
[PREFERENCE] User is unsure about what type of seed to use for the bird feeder.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of getting a birdbath to go along with their feeder.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a birdbath that is easy to clean and maintain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended all-purpose seed mix for attracting a variety of birds includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Black oil sunflower seeds: high in fat and protein, favorite among cardinals, finches, and sparrows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Nyjer seed (thistle): rich in oil, preferred by finches, sparrows, and other small birds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Safflower seeds: good alternative to sunflower seeds, less likely to attract squirrels, favorite among cardinals, finches, and doves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Suet: high-energy food made from animal fat, great for woodpeckers, nuthatches, and chickadees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Fruit and nuts: adding dried fruits and nuts can attract birds like blue jays, woodpeckers, and robins.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested a good all-purpose mix should contain:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * 20-30% black oil sunflower seeds  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * 20-30% Nyjer seed  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * 20-30% safflower seeds  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * 10-20% suet  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * 10-20% fruit and nuts  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended popular bird seed brands: Audubon Park, Perky-Pet, Wild Birds Unlimited, Droll Yankees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for attracting a variety of birds include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Place feeder in an area with morning sun, protected from strong winds and predators.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Keep feeder clean and well-maintained.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Provide a source of water, like a birdbath or pond.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Plant native vegetation and flowers for shelter, food, and nesting sites.
